## What this changes

## Checks

- [ ] I opened this pull request from the GitHub account named in the app id
- [ ] The app repository is public and has a LICENSE permitting redistribution
- [ ] `node .github/scripts/validate.ts <the entry>` passes locally
- [ ] The bundle contains no `.env`, keys, certificates or other secrets
